name: Neon Heart
source:
A retired gun for hire is brought back into her old line of work to help settle a friend's debts. This small favor will drag her back into the world she tried to leave behind, a world full of greed, lust. corruption, corporate conspiracies and mysterious cults, with only an old friend, her girlfriend and a failed prostitute by her side.
